_comment: Community schematics that replace a procedural builder. An entry is only used when approved=true, i.e. after it passed the fidelity review (canon layout, materials and palette; no heavy artistic liberties). Files are Sponge .schem (v2/v3) relative to the repo root; block ids are remapped to the world's version on import. Example entry (disabled):

example_landmark_id.fidelity_review: Checked against: episode references, silhouette, palette, room layout.
